body.statement: For fixed \(k=|\mathcal Z|\) and \(\ell=|\mathcal W|\), the finite structural chart enumeration of \(\mathscr A\) terminates using arithmetic and order tests over \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\). There is an explicit computable constant \(B_{k,\ell}\le 2^{2^{C(k\ell+k+\ell)}}\), for a universal constant \(C\), bounding the number of labeled charts and the algebraic degree over \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\). If every coordinate of \(\zeta\) is an explicitly encoded rational whose numerator and denominator have binary length at most \(L\), a Turing implementation terminates; after clearing denominators, every algebraic target certificate uses a square-free integer polynomial of degree at most \(B_{k,\ell}\) and rational isolating endpoints, and every coefficient and endpoint has bit length at most \(B_{k,\ell}(L+1)^C\). The classification is obtained from the structural charts in \(\mathscr A\), not by reporting generic two-copy quantifier elimination.
body.justification: The field-relative statement separates symbolic exactness for real data from bit complexity for rational encodings.
body.gap: Fixed-dimensional real algebraic decision is known, but no end-to-end field-relative certificate and rational-input size bound exists for this structural response-cycle compiler.
body.consumer: Symbolic implementations can certify real-parameter outputs, while exact-arithmetic implementations can validate rational-data certificates with explicit size bounds.

obligation.what_is_open: Termination, chart-count, algebraic-degree, and rational certificate-size bounds for the specific structural compiler.
obligation.obstruction: The compiler's mixed-support chart enumeration has not been completed, so its chart count and algebraic degrees cannot yet be bounded. A generic real-algebraic decision bound applies to the raw fiber but does not certify the theorem's promised structural method.
obligation.attempted: Counted variables, constraints, and degrees in the fixed-alphabet raw cycle systems, bounded generic real-algebraic decision, and isolated the terminating rank-two and residual-forest branches.
obligation.partial_result: For fixed \(k=\lvert\mathcal Z\rvert\) and \(\ell=\lvert\mathcal W\rvert\), the raw normalized cycle systems contain only finitely many polynomial equalities and weak or strict inequalities, with degree at most two before residual proportionality is eliminated. After deleting redundant simplex coordinates, their variable and constraint counts are bounded by \(C_0(k\ell+k+\ell)\) for a universal \(C_0\). Consequently generic fixed-dimensional real-algebraic decision and sampling give a terminating doubly exponential envelope, and the established all-rank-two structural branch terminates by finite orientation enumeration, linear algebra, and order tests over \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\). The residual-forest argument likewise eliminates its margin block by finitely many ratio and cycle tests. This does not establish the claimed bounds for \(\mathscr A\), because its mixed-support structural chart enumeration has not been completed, and replacing it by generic two-copy quantifier elimination would contradict the theorem's stated classification method.
